title: The facade puts, gets, deletes and lists on typed keys with byte-equal round-trip
asA: developer storing user uploads and generated artefacts as S3-shape objects
iWant: put, get, delete, list verbs on the facade that round-trip bytes without corruption and emit lifecycle events
soThat: my consumer code stays vendor-neutral above the facade and observability wires cleanly

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a putObject through the facade for a known key, a stable content-type, and a 1 KiB payload, when a subsequent getObject reads the key, then the returned bytes equal the put bytes and the content-type header matches; an objectPut lifecycle event fires with key, size=1024, contentType, timestamp.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the facade opened against a running S3-compatible engine and a bucket that exists
acceptanceCriteria.when: putObject(key, contentType='application/octet-stream', body=<1 KiB Buffer>) then getObject(key)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the returned body's byte length equals 1024 and the returned content-type equals application/octet-stream; the events list captured on the sink contains an objectPut record with matching key, size 1024, contentType, timestamp; no body bytes appear in any event record

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a deleteObject through the facade for a known key that exists, when the delete returns, then a getObject on the same key returns a not-found error (S3 NoSuchKey or the storage-side 404-equivalent); an objectDeleted event fires with the key and timestamp.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an object previously put through the facade
acceptanceCriteria.then: the getObject rejects with a not-found shape (NoSuchKey on S3/R2/MinIO); an objectDeleted event fires on the sink with matching key and timestamp

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given at least three objects put under a common key prefix, when listObjects(prefix) is called, then the returned page contains every put key at or under the prefix and a boolean isTruncated indicating whether more pages exist.
acceptanceCriteria.given: three keys previously put under prefix probe/list/
acceptanceCriteria.then: the returned keys include every put key with matching prefix, and the paginated envelope carries an isTruncated boolean
